purpose: Separate evidence above random correspondence from sufficient fidelity under the original operational cutoffs.
unit: A complete method-by-dataset embedding or reference vector, not an independent cell or cell pair.

hypotheses.geometry_unrestricted: Whole-cell correspondence is exchangeable under the null.
hypotheses.geometry_within_annotation: Correspondence within each recorded annotation is exchangeable, conditioning on coarse labelled population structure.
hypotheses.annotation_unrestricted: Annotation assignments are exchangeable while preserving their frequencies.
hypotheses.annotation_within_donor: Heart cell-type assignments are exchangeable within donors, preserving donor-specific label composition.
hypotheses.continuum_unrestricted: Reference pseudotime is exchangeable across cells.
hypotheses.continuum_within_lineage: Reference pseudotime is exchangeable within coarse annotated lineages.
hypotheses.donor_within_cell_type: Donor assignments are exchangeable within cell types. A lower-tail test detects a mixing deficit, not affirmative biological validity.

statistics: One-sided Monte Carlo p=(1+extreme draws)/(B+1), BH adjustment separately for each null family. Central 95% null intervals are not confidence intervals. No inference of universal cutoff validity.
missingness: No zero substitution or pseudotime imputation. Non-finite observations stop geometry analysis; non-finite pseudotime cells are excluded consistently and counted.

panel_matrix.question: Does local overlap exceed random and annotation-conditioned correspondence?
panel_matrix.risk: Above-null overlap need not meet useful fidelity.

panel_matrix.question: Is trustworthiness beyond the correspondence null?
panel_matrix.risk: Random trustworthiness has a nonzero baseline.

panel_matrix.question: Does global distance-rank agreement exceed matched null geometry?
panel_matrix.risk: Sampled pairs are dependent; the permutation unit is the full cell assignment.

panel_matrix.question: Does neighbourhood annotation recovery exceed label-frequency and donor-composition expectations?
panel_matrix.risk: Annotations are not independent biological validation.

panel_matrix.question: Does Paul15 distance-to-pseudotime agreement persist across root and lineage-conditioned references?
panel_matrix.risk: Expression-derived DPT is not a ground-truth temporal ordering.

panel_matrix.question: Does local pseudotime smoothness exceed the lineage-conditioned reference?
panel_matrix.risk: A smooth map alone is not proof of developmental continuity.

panel_matrix.question: Is observed donor mixing below the attainable cell-type-conditioned random reference?
panel_matrix.risk: Failure to detect a deficit does not establish equivalence.
